text:
Yes, a planter is a non-living item, so it can be returned within 30 days of delivery. At 3 weeks you're still inside that window, as long as it's unused and in its original packaging.

As a non-Plus member with a change-of-mind return, a flat $6.95 fee is deducted from your refund. If the planter was $30, you'd get back $23.05 to your original payment method, within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse. Original shipping isn't refunded for a change-of-mind return.

To start, go to "My Orders" and request the return. A prepaid label will be emailed to you, and it expires after 7 days, so drop the parcel off within that time.
